rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when quitting a job or stopping a particular task or activity, often with 喇.
Choose this when someone resigns from a job, office, or position rather than merely stopping a task.

example.english: I’m going to quit my job next month.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 ci4 zik1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that someone will no longer do an activity.

example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zoi3 sik6 jin1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for quitting an addictive or habitual substance or behavior, such as smoking or drinking.

example.english: I’ve decided to quit smoking and won’t buy cigarettes anymore.
example.traditional: 我決定戒煙，唔再買煙喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 gaai3 jin1 m4 zoi3 maai5 jin1 laa3
